objective: Execute every S01-S16 strategy against avoiding tool-driven problem framing and synthesize evidence-grounded ways of escaping it, including logical inversion and attack-to-expand.
underlying_problem: Choose an intervention that achieves the stated outcome within constraints without letting ownership or familiarity with a tool predetermine the diagnosis.
concrete_case: This thread and its sixteen-strategy catalog: does the proposed investigative machinery actually produce different feasible mechanisms, preserve constraints, and enable a useful decision?
incumbent_hypothesis: A rich multi-agent, distillation, and validation workflow is an effective default for escaping tool bias.
assumptions_to_challenge: More strategies or agents necessarily improve decisions.
A structurally valid dispatch is enough to support useful execution.
The smallest unit preserves the important problem.
An opposite claim is a valid logical inference.
constraints: Execute all sixteen strategies requested by user, even if their conclusion is that they are unnecessary for a particular subcase.
Preserve the outcome and evidence boundaries.
Treat current catalog as real artifact evidence and controlled exercises as synthetic empirical evidence.
Use existing explicit authorization; do not invent user interview answers or approval claims.
No production deployment, external communications, irreversible effects, or unrelated dirty-file changes are necessary for this research.
success_measures: Every strategy has executed steps, actual outputs, gate evaluation, a conclusion, limitation, and source-linked evidence.
Concrete mechanisms differ by how they change the outcome, not only names.
Experiments produce actual native-agent outputs and reproducible scoring, retaining ties or negative results.
Independent review verifies every strategy and every dispatched step; no status-only completion.
decision_owner: User owns eventual operational adoption; parent agent selects reversible research details under explicit execution authorization.

authorization.quote: use as many sub agents as needed and execute all strategies, dont stop until we have all of then completed. i'm authorizing all the work already
authorization.scope: All strategy research, native helper work, reversible evidence artifacts, and bounded controlled tests.

round_budget.note: Each of sixteen distinct requested strategy runs has its own finite route budget; sequential steps never reset that budget.
